title: To amend Public Law 115-217 to change the address of the postal facility designated by such Public Law in honor of Sergeant First Class Alwyn Crendall Cashe, and for other purposes.
official_summary: This bill changes the U.S. Postal Service facility designated in Oviedo, Florida, in honor of Sergeant First Class Alwyn Crendall Cashe (from the facility at 567 East Franklin Street to the facility at 83 Geneva Drive).

summary.headline: This law moves the post office named after Sergeant First Class Alwyn Crendall Cashe to a new street address in Oviedo, Florida.
summary.what_it_does: It amends an earlier law that named a U.S. Postal Service facility in Oviedo, Florida, after Sergeant First Class Alwyn Crendall Cashe. The earlier law listed the facility at 567 East Franklin Street, and this law changes that address to 83 Geneva Drive. The naming itself stays the same; only the listed address changes.
